title: Muse Sleep-Onset EEG — EEG/EMG Foundation Challenge 2026, Track 03
description: This dataset comprises 540 at-home EEG recordings from 203 participants collected using Muse S-family wearable headbands, for Track 03 (Sleep onset) of the EEG/EMG Foundation Challenge 2026. Recordings, totaling approximately 157.52 hours, use four channels (TP9, AF7, AF8, TP10) sampled at 128 Hz, with a single annotation marking the onset of the first N2 sleep epoch. The dataset supports development of models predicting time to sleep onset from EEG signals in a causal, at-home monitoring context.
methods_description: EEG was recorded at home using Muse S-family wearable headbands with four channels (TP9, AF7, AF8, TP10) at a stored sampling rate of 128 Hz, possibly downsampled from 256 Hz. Data were exported to BrainVision format using pybv 0.7.5 and organized according to the EEG-BIDS standard. Each recording includes one annotated event marking the first N2 sleep epoch; full sleep-stage scoring was not performed or included.
